title: MCP tools for bindings and chg enrollment

story.i_want_to: read a story's changes and enroll a repo in chg mode through MCP
story.so_that: the new surface is reachable from a session, which is the only way the fleet reaches loopctl

rationale: CLAUDE.md: an operator-facing endpoint is not done until an MCP tool calls it.

acceptance_criteria.description: GET /api/v1/stories/:id/changes returns the story's bindings and each change's applied events, agent role, and a change_binding_get tool calls it.
intake_source_enroll and intake_source_update accept mode: chg and change_events_secret; the secret is write-only and never returned.
Each tool's description states what the endpoint refuses and which key it needs; the declared-and-dispatched wiring test covers the new tool; mcp-server/README.md lists it.

test_cases.name: wiring
steps: run the mcp-server tool wiring test

test_cases.name: secret write-only
preconditions: a source enrolled with a secret

technical_notes: mcp-server is plain ESM tested with node --test.
